description: This file contains test scripts for Git hook failure scenarios, particularly testing the 'proc-receive' hook during push operations, including regular and atomic pushes, with checks for expected output and ref states.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success or failure based on the enclosed commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail; used here to test push failures caused by missing hooks.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output files for test validation.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Checks the current refs in the repository against expected refs.
